facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports that on the handover from KOICA in March 2026 NITDA took over the Nigeria Government Enterprise Architecture (NGEA) framework, built over two and a half years with reference models and described as now operational and enabling data exchange across government agencies; the event is dated by the article's publication date, 2026-03-27.

systems.owner: NITDA (hosted by Galaxy Backbone Limited; built with KOICA)
systems.tiers: federal; pilots at NIMC, Nigeria Customs Service, Nigeria Immigration Service and NITDA
